dedupe_keys.name: benchmarking dataset for the optimal stop location and spacing for a public transport corridor

description: Benchmarking dataset for the Optimal Stop Location and Spacing for a Public Transport Corridor is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Rubens Casalins, César Augusto Henao Botero (Universidad del Norte). The repository contains three main types of data: processed data (P), real data (R), and simulated data (S). Each dataset follows a structured naming convention that indicates its type, the experiment it belongs to, and the specific scenario within that experiment. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
